# Credtent
> Delaware Public Benefit Corporation. Corporate site for content owners and AI companies.

Licenses include the rights the contracting holders warranted, a named manifest, and a disclosure pack your counsel can use for EU AI Act Art. 53 and CA AB 2013 filings. Those statutes still bind the developer. Indemnity, if any, is only as written in the signed license.

## Licensing
- [Home](https://credtent.com/): Credtent is a neutral marketplace that helps content owners and AI companies agree permitted AI uses, value content, and license it for training and for use in AI answers.
- [AI companies](https://credtent.com/ai-companies)
- [Content owners](https://credtent.com/content-owners)
- [AI training](https://credtent.com/ai-training)
- [Citation licensing](https://credtent.com/citation-licensing)
- [Valuation](https://credtent.com/valuation)
- [Company map](https://credtent.com/guides/ai-training-data-licensing-companies/)

Opt-out and Creative Consent: see https://credtent.org/llms.txt
